label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Memorial Struggles for Top Players
items.text: Scottie Scheffler shot an even-par 72 with three straight bogeys and Rory McIlroy posted a 2-over 74, both sitting eight shots behind leader J.T. Poston at the Memorial Tournament.

items.headline: Nelly Korda Surges in Major
items.text: Nelly Korda fired the lowest round of the day to catapult herself into contention alongside Alison Lee and Ruoning Yin in the women's major.

items.headline: Michelle Wie West’s U.S. Open Farewell
items.text: In her one-week return to major championship golf, Michelle Wie West exuded peace during her farewell at the U.S. Women's Open.
